the-office-scoped-note-is-dropped._: Remove the sentence saying the thirteen fields are recorded by the OFFICE instead. The form then reads as thirteen gaps rather than as decision 63. Must kill the STATES test.

the-two-source-hint-is-dropped._: Remove the sentence saying which fact the licensed lines are. A reader then cannot tell the company's LICENCE from what offices have recorded BUYING — the two-source rule's whole point. Must kill the WHICH FACT test.

the-servers-refusal-becomes-generic._: Replace the API's own sentence with the screen's generic load error. Six distinct refusals then read identically, and the one that needs a different person to fix it is indistinguishable. Must kill the server-refusal test.

the-permission-check-is-dropped._: The screen renders its form to a reader who cannot submit it — a control leading to a refusal, which the frontend directive forbids. Must kill the refusal test.
